The '''EU LCS 2016 Summer Split''' was the second split of the 2016 season, organized by Riot Games and held from June 2 to August 28, 2016 in Berlin, Germany, with the finals taking place in Kraków, Poland. The split featured ten teams — seven returning from the [[LCS/Europe/2016/Spring|Spring Split]] and three promoted from the [[LCS/Europe/2016/Summer/Promotion|Summer Promotion Tournament]] — competing in a double round-robin group stage followed by playoffs. [[G2 Esports]] entered the split as the defending champions, while [[FC Schalke 04 Esports]] made their LCS debut after acquiring [[Elements]]’ slot.
